Artist.description: Full primary artist string. Vocalist appears at the END as `Ft. Name` (with period). If exactly two artists, join with `&` or `vs` (depending on what's already there). Three or more artists use commas. Do NOT put vocalist in the title.

Title.description: Track title. Keep descriptors like `(Extended Mix)` and remix tags like `(Artist Name Remix)`. Do NOT include `(Original Mix)`.

Album.description: Album/release title. Use null for single-track releases. If there is only one file present, but the track indicates it is part of a release with multiple tracks, do NOT consider it as a single, keep track disc and album.

Remixer.description: Populate if the title contains a remix tag `(Artist Name Remix)`. The remixer name should match that tag and follow the same artist formatting rules, else null.

Publisher.description: Label/publisher. All tracks in the same release should share the same publisher. May be null if unknown.

CatalogId.description: Catalog ID for the release. All tracks in the same release should share the same catalog ID. May be null if unknown.

Year.description: Release year, or null if unknown.

Genre.description: Primary genre as free text. Common values: Hardcore, Trance, Hard Trance.

DiscNumber.description: Disc field formatted as `d/a` where `d` is the disc number and `a` is total discs. Omit for true singles. For a single-disc multi-track release, use `1/1`.

TrackNumber.description: Track field formatted as `t/a` where `t` is track number and `a` is total tracks in the disc/release. Use null for singles. `1/1` is NEVER valid.

Track.description: Single track entry following the formatting rules.
